repair_obligation.python_template_fix: Escape the backslash at the JavaScript-template layer so generated Python receives the two characters backslash+n in sys.version.replace('\n', ' ').
repair_obligation.git_head_receipt_fix: Change the printf format to SANITIZED_GIT_HEAD=%s.
repair_obligation.rerun: Run the same regression/acceptance matrix on the repaired exact PR781 head in an actually-started Vercel Sandbox; do not substitute VPS/self-hosted/production hosts.
repair_obligation.promotion_gate: Require full offline matrix, byte-identical twin one-file EntityOS builds, exact artifact digest, status/self-test/no-host-Python/state-restart/capability/relocation gates, DENY_ALL during tests, and successful Sandbox stop before merge/promotion.
